branches.aiMerged: Auto-merge is on, so it was merged into main without approval
branches.copyGone.create: copy in value is gone. A branch sees all of main, so no copy is needed (to read or write inside a branch, name it with the branch argument of the other tools)
branches.copyGone.update: copy in value is gone. A branch sees all of main, so no copy is needed
branches.delete.hasChanges: branch {name} is not deleted, as it has {changes} changed cards and sections (see what changed with branch_read; to discard them and delete, use discard: true in value)
branches.delete.stillNamed: The branch field of {cards} still points at the deleted branch {name} (pick a branch to work in again, or leave the field empty)
branches.merge.conflicts: Not merged, as there are {count} conflicts. Choose with take in value and call again: {shown}
branches.merge.overlaps: Not merged, as the same path holds different things (rename or delete one of them, then merge): {shown}
branches.merge.placesLeft: places: true also takes the positions moved on the branch
branches.merge.sameEnds: The merge source and the merge target are the same
branches.merge.stillNamed: The branch field of {cards} still points at the branch {name} that was set aside. If the work is done, card_action with op: finish completes the goal and empties the field; to go on, op: start makes a branch of another name
branches.notBranch: {raw} is not a branch (check the name with branch_list)
branches.read.afterShape: after is the next of the previous answer (a commit's seq)
branches.read.asOneOf: as is one of diff, history or diagram (got {other})
branches.read.fullWithoutPath: full and after go with path (the cards or sections whose contents to read)
branches.read.limitRange: limit is a count from 1 to 1000
branches.read.noDiff: {name} is not a branch, so it has no difference from main (read as: history or diagram in value; inspections with inspection_list. With against, a preview of merging into it)
branches.read.notInCommit: Commit {seq} did not change {path} (path is a card or a section as it was before or after the commit)
branches.read.pathInMain: {path} was changed in main after the branch was made, not by the branch (read it on main with card_read; bring it in with branch_merge, main as target)
branches.read.pathNotChanged: The branch did not change {path} (path is a changed one's path now, or a removed or moved one's path before. It changed: {changed})
branches.read.pathShape: path is the path of a card or a section, or an array of them
branches.read.pathWithAgainst: path (the before and after) does not go with against (a merge preview): read them one at a time
branches.read.seqShape: seq is the commit's number (a whole number)
branches.read.seqWithLimit: seq reads one commit, so it does not go with limit
branches.read.withSeq: path and full go with seq (the number of the commit to read)
branches.revert.said: main is not rewritten; branch {made} was made, shaped as right after commit {seq}. Put it into main with branch_merge (target: {made}); while main is locked, that becomes an MR
branches.revert.toOrUndo: Give value one of to (go back to there) or undo (undo one commit alone)
branches.revert.toShape: to is a commit number (an integer from 0)
branches.revert.undoSaid: main is not rewritten: branch {made} was made with what commit {seq} changed undone. Put it into main with branch_merge (target: {made}); while main is locked it becomes an MR
branches.revert.undoShape: undo is the number of the commit to undo (a whole number, 0 or more)
branches.undo.conflicts: Refused, nothing written: later commits changed the same places as commit {seq} (a commit is never undone in part; {count} places): {shown}
branches.verifyGone: as: verify is gone. Read inspections with inspection_list (one item's content with inspection_read, the as-designed mark with inspection_update)
